_source: READ-ONLY recording of the public snapshot endpoint (otto-twin-control /sim_runs/<id>/snapshot, the same call the cockpit polls) for live sim_run 6a8a7029-e7c4-4521-a4f5-606e48e2a465, busy_day, twin depot, speed_x 8, polled every ~2 s from 2026-09-22 18:14Z. Frames keep only (state, stall_id) changes and reservation changes; SoC-only changes are dropped. No writes were made.
_shape: as twinRun.live0922.json, plus optional per-frame `reserved_set` (stall->vehicle, delta) / `reserved_clear` (stall ids) `faulted` stall ids (full list when any) - both published as stalls_status in the replayed snapshot - and `legs_set` / `legs_clear`: the newest TRAVEL leg of each vehicle as [seq, end_sim], as deltas. A vehicle that left the feed carries state "__gone__".
